test_run_boost_build_tests: run the Boost.Build testing module test suite to verify run, link, and compile test rules
test_run_fail_scenarios: test the run-fail rule by verifying expected failures for compile, link, and run stages
test_link_and_compile_rules: test the link and compile testing rules to verify successful and expected failure outcomes
test_run_with_args_and_input: test the run rule with command-line arguments and input files to verify argument and file handling
test_files_with_spaces: test compile and compile-fail rules with source files that contain spaces in their names
